RestoreBehavior: Applied once to loaded save data. A later in-game save can keep this value. Disable all effects and disconnect leave it applied.
Name: Rescue-use counter
Description: Sets the saved counter used in subsequent native Mickey rescue rolls. Requires living Sora in stable gameplay. The separate appearance statistic is preserved, and native mission and party rules still apply.

Evidence.Finding: The unsigned 16-bit counter is the exponent in the native selection formula. The trainer writes only these two bytes after scene, thread, host and living-Sora checks; no RNG or actor function is called.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA and independent source review; synthetic guards are covered in PlayerBridgeTests.cpp. No live validation in this review.

RestoreBehavior: Read only. No game state is changed.
Name: Recorded Mickey appearances
Description: Displays the separate saved statistic labelled MICKEY APPEAR by the native debug screen. Editing the rescue-use counter leaves this statistic unchanged.

Evidence.Finding: The native statistics widget reads the adjacent unsigned 16-bit word. Native Mickey construction increments each counter independently, capped at 999.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA and independent source review; synthetic guards are covered in PlayerBridgeTests.cpp. No live validation in this review.

RestoreBehavior: Read only. No game state is changed.
Name: Conditional rescue roll threshold
Description: Displays max(decay raised to the rescue-use count, minimum threshold) as a percentage. The native roll also depends on game-over type, mission permission and party conditions. Even a 100% threshold does not guarantee Mickey appears.

Evidence.Finding: Native selection uses powf(parameters+216, use count), a floor at parameters+220, and a strict comparison against its random value. The readout computes the threshold without advancing RNG.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA and independent source review; synthetic guards are covered in PlayerBridgeTests.cpp. No live validation in this review.

RestoreBehavior: Read only. No game state is changed.
Name: Mission permits rescue
Description: Shows whether the loaded mission resource has its native Mickey rescue permission flag. This permission is one part of the game's selection rules.

Evidence.Finding: The permission is bit 0x200 in the 16-bit mission resource flags at resource+4. Missing missions report zero; malformed resources are omitted.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA and independent source review; synthetic guards are covered in PlayerBridgeTests.cpp. No live validation in this review.

RestoreBehavior: Read only. No game state is changed.
Name: Game-over object active
Description: Shows whether a validated native game-over object is present. Its type, phase and rescue selection appear below while available.

Evidence.Finding: The constructor publishes the game-over object. Diagnostics require a readable object and supported type, phase and rescue-flag values.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA and independent source review; synthetic guards are covered in PlayerBridgeTests.cpp. No live validation in this review.

RestoreBehavior: Read only. No game state is changed.
Name: Game-over type
Description: Displays the native game-over type code from 0 to 3. Initial Mickey selection is evaluated by the inspected type-0 path.

Evidence.Finding: The game-over object stores its type at offset 0. The initial rescue decision is conditional on type 0, mission permission and native party rules.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA and independent source review; synthetic guards are covered in PlayerBridgeTests.cpp. No live validation in this review.

RestoreBehavior: Read only. No game state is changed.
Name: Game-over phase
Description: Displays the current native game-over state code from 0 to 8. It is available only while the validated object exists.

Evidence.Finding: The game-over state machine reads its integer phase at object+16. The trainer reports supported states without changing the sequence.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA and independent source review; synthetic guards are covered in PlayerBridgeTests.cpp. No live validation in this review.

RestoreBehavior: Read only. No game state is changed.
Name: Mickey rescue selected
Description: Displays the current game-over object's rescue-selection flag. It reflects the native decision for this sequence; it does not spawn Mickey or confirm that his actor is already active.

Evidence.Finding: The selection byte is object+20. Native initial selection and subsequent reroll logic own this field; the trainer only reads it.
Evidence.Level: Static IDA and independent source review; synthetic guards are covered in PlayerBridgeTests.cpp. No live validation in this review.
